_about: The letters and short names in Liebermann's notes, law by law: what each stands for there, shown when the reader points at it and linked to the Manuscripts guide or the Works cited. The same letters can mean different things in different laws (in Henry I's laws Wi is Wilkins's edition; elsewhere Wi is a Worcester manuscript), so each law has its own list. Only letters in Liebermann's italic are looked at, where he prints his sigla. law.html applies it to the notes of the clauses whose id begins with the key (Hn_...).
